title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Partial Claim Ceiling Uplift for Disability Compensation Recipients
content:
The ceiling percentage for a VA partial claim on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan is raised by a service-connected uplift where the veteran's Disability Compensation award is running, according to the award's combined rating.

## Service-connected uplift

| The veteran's Disability Compensation award | Uplift added to the ceiling percentage |
|---|---|
| Running, combined rating of at least 70 percent | 5 percentage points (the higher uplift) |
| Running, combined rating of at least 30 percent but below 70 | 2.5 percentage points (the lower uplift) |
| Otherwise (no award, an award that is not running, or a running award below 30 percent) | Not raised (0) |

The higher uplift rating is 70 and the lower uplift rating is 30; a rating equal to a threshold falls on that threshold's row.

## Combinations (hypothetical awards)

| Award status | Combined rating | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| Running | 80 | 5 |
| Running | 70 | 5 |
| Running | 60 | 2.5 |
| Running | 30 | 2.5 |
| Running | 20 | 0 |
| Not running | 90 | 0 |
| No award | — | 0 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

With a ceiling percentage of 30 and a running award at a combined rating of 70, the percentage applied is 30 plus 5, or 35; on an unpaid principal balance of 100,000.00 dollars at the first unpaid installment that gives 35,000.00 dollars.
